summary.text: Matt Danieluk is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he is running against incumbent Brian Lanoue (R).
On his campaign website he describes himself as a lifelong resident of Lisbon and Griswold who works as a Realtor and paraprofessional and serves as Third Selectman in Griswold.

paragraphs.text: Danieluk says on his campaign website that he is also a basketball coach, has a wife and two sons, and spent many years working as a bartender.
The website lists Griswold, Lisbon, Preston, Voluntown and Ledyard as the towns he is seeking to represent.
His site lists affordability, education funding, resources for municipalities, workers' rights and guardrails on artificial intelligence among his key issues.
Ballotpedia lists the Connecticut AFL-CIO among his endorsements.
